questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible in the center of the frame, exactly three pens are present.
All three pens are aligned vertically with the black caps pointing downwards and the barrels pointing upwards.
All three pens appear identical in color, featuring dark barrels/caps.
All three pens appear complete with caps on; no bare writing tips or shortened pens are visible.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right side without stopping or reversing.

parsed.reason: The video shows a normal operation where a board carrying three identical, correctly oriented pens moves smoothly from left to right. No defects or motion failures are observed.

description: Three identical pens moving left to right on the board, smooth continuous motion.
